fullContentHtml:
RPSC Veterinary Officer Final Answer Key / Marks / Merit List 2026 – Full Details

Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) has released the Final Answer Key / Marks / Merit List for the post of Veterinary Officer. This recruitment was released for 1100 posts. Applications for the Rajasthan RPSC Veterinary Officer Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 05 August 2025 to 03 September 2025. The written examination was on 19 April 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their RPSC Veterinary Officer Final Answer Key / Marks / Merit List 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 17 July 2025
  • Application Start Date : 05 August 2025
  • Last Date : 03 September 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 03 September 2025
  • Exam Date : 19 April 2026
  • Admit Card : 16 April 2026
  • Answer Key : 01 May 2026
  • Final Answer Key : 05 October 2026
  • Final Marks : 05 October 2026
  • Merit List : 05 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General / Other State : Rs. 600/-
  • OBC / BC : Rs. 400/-
  • SC / ST : Rs. 400/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 500/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.
